rationale: The agent appears to have canceled an entire order (#W1845024) and announced a refund without first authenticating the user, verifying which items were the “office” vs “hiking” items, or confirming the cancellation with the user. The user asked for partial cancellation (office items only) if possible, otherwise to change the shipping address; the agent neither attempted a partial item modification nor proposed/addressed an address change. There is no evidence of retrieving order details across the listed orders or confirming any order-changing action prior to executing it, which violates the policy. The stated refund details (amount, PayPal destination, and timing) are presented without visible tool outputs to support them. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
